newsitem.title: INDIA: India Hotel Leela postpones board meet.
newsitem.headline: India Hotel Leela postpones board meet.

text.p: The board of Hotel Leela Venture has postponed its meeting to November 11 to discuss the firm's first half results for 1996/97, a company official told Reuters.
The meeting was supposed to take place on Friday. The company official did not give any reason for the postponement.
Hotel Leela shares were unchanged at 86.25 rupees on Friday at the Bombay Stock Exchange with over 4,000 shares traded by early afternoon.

Hotel Leela Venture runs Bombay's Leela Kempinski and the Leela Beach in Goa. The firm announced a 97 percent rise in net profit to 440.38 million rupees in the year ended 1995/96 (April-March) over its year-ago period.
